mapper.sql: cp.id AS id, COALESCE(NULLIF(cp.slug, ''), CONCAT('post-', cp.id)) AS slug, cp.title AS title, cp.summary AS summary, cc.category_name AS category, cc.category_code AS categorySlug, su.nickname AS author, DATE_FORMAT(cp.published_time, '%Y-%m-%d') AS publishedAt, cp.reading_minutes AS readingMinutes, cp.cover_tone AS coverTone, cp.is_featured AS featured, cp.ranking AS ranking, cp.view_count AS views, cp.like_count AS likes, cp.favorite_count AS favorites, IFNULL(col.title, '') AS `column`
FROM content_post cp LEFT JOIN content_category cc ON cc.id = cp.category_id LEFT JOIN sys_user su ON su.id = cp.author_id LEFT JOIN content_column col ON col.id = cp.column_id
WHERE cp.publish_status = 1 AND cp.deleted = 0 AND cp.visibility = 1
mapper.select:
SELECT
AND cp.is_featured = 1 ORDER BY cp.published_time DESC, cp.id DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT
ORDER BY cp.is_featured DESC, cp.published_time DESC, cp.id DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT
AND (cp.slug = #{slug} OR CONCAT('post-', cp.id) = #{slug}) LIMIT 1

SELECT
AND NOT (cp.slug = #{slug} OR CONCAT('post-', cp.id) = #{slug}) AND ( cp.category_id = (SELECT p0.category_id FROM content_post p0 WHERE (p0.slug = #{slug} OR CONCAT('post-', p0.id) = #{slug}) LIMIT 1) OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM content_post_tag cur_pt JOIN content_post base_p ON (base_p.slug = #{slug} OR CONCAT('post-', base_p.id) = #{slug}) JOIN content_post_tag base_pt ON base_pt.post_id = base_p.id WHERE cur_pt.post_id = cp.id AND cur_pt.tag_id = base_pt.tag_id ) ) ORDER BY cp.published_time DESC, cp.id DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT
AND ( cp.title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR cp.summary LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM content_post_tag pt JOIN content_tag t ON t.id = pt.tag_id WHERE pt.post_id = cp.id AND t.status = 1 AND t.tag_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') ) )
ORDER BY cp.published_time DESC, cp.id DESC
